cases.description: Videos of police, firefighters, soldiers, medics and other first responders actually doing their job.
cases.label: First responders on duty
cases.definition: Member only if the item text establishes both: (1) a central person is identified as a police officer (any branch, incl. auxiliary or court police), firefighter, soldier/armed police, doctor, nurse, paramedic or professional rescue worker; (2) the text describes them actively doing that job in the events shown (rescuing, treating, testing, questioning, arresting, mediating, escorting, investigating), or states that they are on duty in those events (e.g. 执勤, 出警, 抗洪). Not members: they only issue a notice, statement or advice; are the victim or subject of a court case; appear off duty, in a skit, drama, dance or costume; or their role or duty is only implied.

cases.description: Stuff that happens overseas, or where the people in it are foreigners.
cases.label: Set abroad or about foreigners
cases.definition: Member only if the item text establishes either: (a) the scene or the reported event takes place in a named or explicitly foreign country (not mainland China, Hong Kong, Macao or Taiwan), or (b) the main people are explicitly identified as foreign nationals or foreigners (老外, 外国人, 美国人, etc.). Not members: Chinese people or officials discussing foreign matters from China; Chinese places said to look like abroad; people who hold or regained Chinese nationality; Taiwan/Hong Kong residents; foreign brands or words without a stated foreign setting or person.

cases.description: Clips where you see someone or something before and after a makeover.
cases.label: Before-and-after transformation in the clip
cases.definition: Member only if the item text indicates the video itself shows the same person, animal, object or picture in a before state and an after state of a visible change in appearance or condition. Counts: outfit/makeup transformation clips (titles or hashtags such as 变装, 换装, 变身, 最强变身术), makeup removal, photo restoration, side-by-side results. Not members: figurative turnarounds (career 逆袭, grades), behaviour comparisons (before vs after marriage, then vs now), policies about renovation, workouts promising future change, or merely wearing a costume.

cases.description: 下雨刮风、发大水这种天气里拍的视频。
cases.label: 雨雪风暴或洪涝天气中的场景
cases.definition: 同时满足才算：(1) 文字表明视频画面或所报道的事件发生在下雨（不论大小）、下雪、冰雹、台风或大风等天气中，或发生在这类天气造成的洪水、内涝、积水现场（含抗洪救灾现场）；(2) 这种天气或其后果是视频里真实出现的情境，而不是比喻、顺口溜、天气知识或与画面无关的口号。不算：晴天、高温、彩虹、晚霞；只有口号式标签（如“洪水无情人间有爱”）而没说明画面内容；泡水车之类的事后纠纷；拿天气开玩笑或作比喻（如“下雨不愁”）。

cases.description: 视频里提到具体多少钱的，比如价格、工资、罚款、赔偿这些。
cases.label: 提到具体金额
cases.definition: 只要文字中明确出现一个具体的金钱数额就算：数字或汉字数字 + 货币单位（元、块、万元、美元、¥等），表示价格、花费、收入、工资、罚款、赔偿、悬赏、涉案金额等。比喻或引语中的具体金额也算。不算：只说“钱”“省钱”“欠多少钱”而没有具体数额；“几两碎银”这类不确定说法；数字后的“块”“万”不是货币含义（如“2块鸡块”、未说明单位的“35万”）；斤、岁、年、电话号码等其他数字。

cases.description: 外卖小哥、快递员、摆摊的、工地师傅这些普通劳动者干活的视频。
cases.label: 基层劳动者的工作场景
cases.definition: 同时满足才算：(1) 文字明确指出视频的主要人物是以下劳动者之一：外卖骑手、快递员、环卫工、建筑/装修/高空作业工人、搬运工或背夫、保安、保洁、餐厅服务员、货车或出租车司机、街头摆摊者，及同类一线体力或服务劳动者；(2) 内容与其工作有关：正在干活或送单、在工作场所、工作装备或工服、收入或经营情况，而不只是顺带一提。不算：职业只用作比喻、玩笑或撩人台词；角色扮演；只谈外卖/快递政策或公司而无具体劳动者；“打工”泛指上班而没有具体职业；故事里顺带出现的司机。
